verdict.rationale: Kit's API exposes broadcast-level performance metrics (opens, clicks, unsubscribes, link click rates) via documented, paginated, authenticated endpoints (kit-docs-36, kit-docs-37, kit-docs-34, kit-docs-30), which supports pulling campaign metrics into an external system. However there is no documented endpoint for 'flow' (sequence/automation) performance metrics, and no mention of warehouse/BI export tooling or examples of dashboard integration. Missing for 10: automation/flow-specific performance/stats endpoints, evidence of warehouse/dashboard integration patterns or partner tooling, independent confirmation of metric completeness.
